visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a black t-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor space with white tiled walls. He gestures toward a metal rack holding a dense, tangled collection of colorful plastic and wire hangers. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the hangers, showing a chaotic mix of blue, green, and white ones hooked onto a white horizontal rod. (3) The man returns to view, holding a blue-rimmed prop, speaking with an expressive facial expression while standing in the middle of the frame. (4) Two other young men, one wearing a tan cap and green shirt, another with a black graphic tee, enter the scene from the left, examining the laundry area and hangers with curious expressions. (5) The group moves to look at a white mesh laundry basket overflowing with dirty white garments. The man in the cap points at the clothes. (6) A man dressed in a maid costume with pigtails and a white apron appears suddenly, holding two green bags of Persil laundry pods. He smiles widely and points at the products. (7) Close-up shots focus on the Persil Power Caps packaging, showing the 'Color' and 'Universal' variants with bright green and blue graphics. (8) The maid character demonstrates putting a green laundry pod into the drum of a top-loading washing machine, followed by placing the dirty laundry inside. (9) A white t-shirt is held up showing a large brown sauce stain on the chest, followed by a transition showing the same shirt completely clean and white. (10) The final scene shows the whole group laughing and gesturing in the laundry room, with the maid character winking at the camera.

It starts by highlighting common laundry pain points (tangled hangers, messy rooms, stained clothes) and introduces a 'cleaning elf' character to present Persil as the ultimate convenient solution for deep cleaning and odor removal.
